title: Spacecraft momentum anomalies in the Van Allen belts
summary: Charles tells of Spacecraft momentum anomalies in the Van Allen belts, about space age at Van Allen belts, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

plain: A guest named Charles, speaking on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, says that spacecraft circling the Earth show odd changes in their motion when they reach the Van Allen belts, zones of charged particles that surround the planet. He says they either speed up or slow down for no clear reason, which he offers as a hint of physics we do not yet understand.
